title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-29
source: SBD>MR : Shure line mixers > Sony reel to reel (middle of          the line model, exact model          unknown) at 7 1/2 ips onto          BASF 90 minute reels          MR>CDR: Revox A77 reel to reel > Alesis Masterlink ML960

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a warm NRPS warm‑up and minor track‑labeling issues; overall good listening experience.
ai_review.review: The set captures a fun NRPS warm‑up that many reviewers remember fondly, and despite some track‑title misplacements the audio itself is solid. No major sound quality complaints were noted, leading to an overall positive impression of this performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review was provided; it praises the music and mentions no audio problems, so the rating leans toward good but confidence is low due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Track titles are misaligned (track 19 includes tuning and Cumberland Blues; subsequent tracks shifted, track 25 is Hard to Handle). No complaints about clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Track numbering errors cause a shift in the displayed setlist, but the musical flow remains intact.
